spec.expr:
(
  sum by(service) (rate(finpos_http_requests_total{service="MB Furnistore", status="200"}[10m])) 
  / 
  sum by(service) (rate(finpos_http_requests_total{service="MB Furnistore"}[10m]))
) * 100

(
  sum by(service) (increase(finpos_http_requests_total{service="MB Furnistore", status="200"}[10m]))
  /
  sum by(service) (increase(finpos_http_requests_total{service="MB Furnistore"}[10m]))
) * 100
sum by(endpoint, method, service, status) (increase(finpos_http_requests_total{job="backend", endpoint=~".*sales-invoice.*", status!~"2.*"}[10m]))
sum by(endpoint, mehtod, service, status) (increase(finpos_http_requests_total{job="backend", endpoint=~".*sales-quotation.*", status!~"2.*"}[10m]))
sum by(endpoint, service, method, status) (increase(finpos_http_requests_total{job="backend", endpoint=~".*sales-order.*", status!~"2.*"}[10m]))
sum by(endpoint, method, service, status) (increase(finpos_http_requests_total{job="backend", endpoint=~".*delivery-order.*", status!~"2.*"}[10m]))
sum by(endpoint, method, service, status) (increase(finpos_http_requests_total{job="backend", endpoint=~".*sales-advance.*", status!~"2.*"}[10m]))
sum by(endpoint, service, method, status) (rate(finpos_http_requests_total{job="backend", endpoint=~".*sales-payment.*", status!~"2.*"}[10m]))
sum by(endpoint, method, service, status) (increase(finpos_http_requests_total{job="backend", endpoint=~".*sales-return.*", status!~"2.*"}[10m]))

(
  sum by(status) (rate(finpos_http_requests_total{job="backend", endpoint!~"/api/ping|/api/v1/metrics", status!~"2.*|403"}[24h]))
  / ignoring(status) group_left 
  sum(rate(finpos_http_requests_total{job="backend", endpoint!~"/api/ping|/api/v1/metrics"}[24h]))
)
